graphics:amd-780m.note: Phoenix/Hawk Point candidate for the named 7840U/8840U models. GC 11.0.1, PSP 13.0.4, SDMA 6.0.1, VCN 4.0.2 and DCN 3.1.4. Marketing-name to IP mapping remains a provisional inference until target PCI/IP discovery and runtime evidence exist.

graphics:amd-880m.note: Strix Point candidate for Ryzen AI 9 365: GC 11.5.0, PSP 14.0.0, SDMA 6.1.0, VCN 4.0.5, VPE 6.1.0 and DCN 3.5.0. Does not include Strix Halo, Krackan or later GC 11.5 variants; runtime hardware verification remains open.

graphics:amd-ai-z2-extreme.note: Provisional Strix Point graphics candidate shared with Z2 Extreme; this graphics group excludes NPU firmware. Exact device PCI/IP discovery and runtime evidence remain unvalidated.

graphics:amd-z1.note: Provisional Phoenix 2 candidate: GC 11.0.4 and PSP 13.0.11, with the shared SDMA 6.0.1 / VCN 4.0.2 / DCN 3.1.4 group. The exact Z1 device IP discovery has not been observed; do not infer this from RDNA3 or CU count alone. Revise the group if a target identifies a different silicon variant.

graphics:amd-z1-extreme.note: Provisional Phoenix candidate, separate from the non-Extreme Z1 Phoenix 2 group. Exact target PCI/IP discovery and runtime evidence remain unvalidated.

graphics:amd-z2.note: Provisional Hawk Point candidate sharing the named 780M/Phoenix firmware IP group. Exact Z2 target PCI/IP discovery and runtime evidence remain unvalidated.

graphics:amd-z2-a.note: Provisional Van Gogh graphics candidate for Z2 A. Zen2/RDNA2 and CU count alone do not establish the exact stepping or firmware group; retain this uncertainty until device PCI/IP discovery and runtime evidence exist.

graphics:amd-z2-extreme.note: Provisional Strix Point candidate. Does not include GC 11.5.1/11.5.2 or a driver-wide union. Confirm exact Z2 Extreme PCI/IP discovery and runtime firmware requests before a hardware-support claim.

graphics:amd-z2-go.note: Provisional Rembrandt / Yellow Carp graphics candidate. Only the 11 paths declared by the audited target kernels are selected; WHENCE's additional yellow_carp_asd.bin is deliberately excluded. Z2 Go silicon identity and runtime requests still require target evidence.

graphics:intel-g3.note: Provisional Panther Lake candidate. SteamOS 3.10 target xe module declares all five paths; its image already contains PTL GuC/HuC/GSC and xe3lpd_dmc, but lacks xe3lpd_3002_dmc. The two DMC alternatives correspond to display IP 3000/3002 and are retained as a narrow family candidate until exact display IP is known. xe3p_lpd_dmc belongs to display IP 3500 and is excluded. The 3.8.14 target declares only the legacy DMC path and no PTL GuC/HuC/GSC, so adding these bytes cannot establish PTL driver support. Exact G3/G3 Extreme PCI/display IP and runtime behavior remain unvalidated.
